schema.description: Cursor for pagination. When provided, filters are embedded in the cursor so you only need to pass cursor and pageSize. value.description: Search value. String or number for most operators. Array for 'in' operator (max 100 items).

schema.description: Page number (1-indexed) for offset-based pagination. Limited to offset of 100,000 records. For deep pagination, use cursor-based pagination instead.
